extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed final mechanism ontology record; direct claims are limited to assays actually present in local XML/PDF/figure captions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Acidicin P damages the Listeria monocytogenes cell envelope and cytoplasmic membrane, supported by microscopy and membrane integrity assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Direct assay supports membrane/cell-envelope damage in L. monocytogenes; it does not establish a single protein receptor target.

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=9:Acidicin P destroyed the morphological and intracellular structure of L. monocytogenes.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The A5xxxG9 motif in Adpalpha and S16xxxG20 motif in Adpbeta, plus selected charged residues, are important for acidicin P activity.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: wild-type acidicin P and T1-T6 variants
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mutagenesis supports residue contribution to activity; the exact atomic interaction remains supported by modeling rather than direct structural determination.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Molecular dynamics supports a membrane-inserted antiparallel helix-helix dimer model for the two peptides.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Computational model is supporting context and is not treated as direct target validation.
